subject: ENX / Enel X Way Italia national direct-payment rebuild and targeted retry

decision.reason: Current APK 4.3.67 and public station-detail API validate directPaymenthPrice as a distinct direct/ad-hoc tariff surface. A fresh national PUN rebuild plus exact serial/EVSE mapping produces 21,866 rankable current ENX EVSE after targeted retry. Residual EVSE remain fail-closed because station-detail errors or exact identity mismatches persist; no class/national extrapolation is used.

directPaymentModel.separationRule: Never substitute app/eMSP price for directPaymenthPrice.

directEnergyPricesObserved.scope: AC / lower-power direct-payment plugs in current mapped perimeter
DC/HPC direct-payment plugs in current mapped perimeter

directPaymentModel.penaltySemantics: Current APK states a 60-minute post-charge idle window and that the amount is shown in the single-plug detail. Current Enel service terms likewise tie applicability/amount to the station detail. Direct-payment penalty values remain stored separately from energy price; no unsupported overnight/time-window extrapolation is applied.

mainReasons: 577 station serials still return Enel businessCode 12500 / evOs generic error after retry.
Other serials return station data but no deterministic current ENX PUN EVSE match after legacy EVO->ENX normalization.
No tariff is inferred from power class, nearby station, app Pay Per Use grid, or roaming/eMSP surface.
failClosedResidual.resumeCondition: Only resume residuals from a successful current station-detail response with an exact ENX EVSE match, a first-party QR/direct-payment payload, or newer authoritative PUN/Enel identity evidence. Generic ENX tariff search is exhausted.

decision.statusRationale: Remain partial because 1,154 current PUN ENX EVSE are still fail-closed. The 21,866 exact EVSE are individually rankable and may be used by TCC.
